title: Round after every add
hints: There are two additions here, so an f32 machine rounds twice. Count the calls to `to_f32` in the starter.
Round the first sum before the second addition uses it.
The return line becomes `return to_f32(to_f32(a + b) + c)`.
prompt: sum3(a, b, c) should add three f32 values the way an f32 machine does: a + b first, then + c, rounding to f32 after each addition. to_f32 is written. The starter rounds only once, at the end, so sum3(16777216.0, 1.0, 1.0) gives 16777218 where an f32 machine gives 16777216. Repair it.

answer.explain: An f32 machine rounds the result of every operation, so `a + b` is rounded before `c` is added, and that sum is rounded again. With 16777216, 1 and 1, the first sum rounds back to 16777216 and so does the second. Rounding once at the end gives 16777218, a number no f32 machine would produce here.
